title: The parser finds a U+003E (>) code point where an attribute value is expected (e.g., <div id=>).
summary: The parser treats the attribute as having an empty value.

title: The parser finds a DOCTYPE that is missing a name (e.g., <!DOCTYPE>).
summary: In such a case, if the DOCTYPE is correctly placed as a document preamble, the parser sets the Document to quirks mode.

title: The parser finds a U+003E (>) code point where start of the DOCTYPE public identifier is expected (e.g., <!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC >).
summary: In such a case, if the DOCTYPE is correctly placed as a document preamble, the parser sets the Document to quirks mode.

title: The parser finds a U+003E (>) code point where start of the DOCTYPE system identifier is expected (e.g., <!DOCTYPE html SYSTEM >).
summary: In such a case, if the DOCTYPE is correctly placed as a document preamble, the parser sets the Document to quirks mode.

title: The parser finds a U+003E (>) code point where an end tag name is expected, i.e., </>.
summary: The parser ignores the whole "</>" code point sequence.

title: The parser finds the DOCTYPE public identifier that is not preceded by a quote (e.g., <!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC -//W3C//DTD HTML 4.01//EN">).
summary: In such a case, the parser ignores the public identifier, and if the DOCTYPE is correctly placed as a document preamble, sets the Document to quirks mode.

title: The parser finds the DOCTYPE system identifier that is not preceded by a quote (e.g., <!DOCTYPE html SYSTEM http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml1/DTD/xhtml1-transitional.dtd">).
summary: In such a case, the parser ignores the system identifier, and if the DOCTYPE is correctly placed as a document preamble, sets the Document to quirks mode.

title: The parser finds a character reference that is not terminated by a U+003B (;) code point.
summary: The parser behaves the same as if the character reference is terminated by the U+003B (;) code point.

title: The parser finds a DOCTYPE whose "PUBLIC" keyword and public identifier are not separated by ASCII whitespace.
summary: In this case the parser behaves as if ASCII whitespace is present.

title: The parser finds a DOCTYPE whose "SYSTEM" keyword and system identifier are not separated by ASCII whitespace.
summary: In this case the parser behaves as if ASCII whitespace is present.

title: The parser finds a DOCTYPE whose "DOCTYPE" keyword and name are not separated by ASCII whitespace.
summary: In this case the parser behaves as if ASCII whitespace is present.

title: The parser finds attributes that are not separated by ASCII whitespace (e.g., <div id="foo"class="bar">).
summary: In this case the parser behaves as if ASCII whitespace is present.

title: The parser finds a DOCTYPE whose public and system identifiers are not separated by ASCII whitespace.
summary: In this case the parser behaves as if ASCII whitespace is present.
